conclusion: Across 1,520 shared dates after the source-quality screen and 6 balancing authorities, the day-ahead minus seasonal-naive score averaged -5.14 percentage points. The 95% HAC interval spanned 0.943 points versus 0.304 under independence.

next_decision: Publish uncertainty for paired calendar dates and sensitivity to block length. Treat published historical forecast errors as observations and the simulation as a coverage experiment.

study_design.protocol: For each full UTC date compute the paired difference in daily demand-normalized absolute errors. Average seven consecutive calendar dates; join six authorities by date. Compare independent, non-overlapping weekly, Bartlett HAC and moving-block intervals. In a separate controlled experiment run the identical procedures against a known population mean. Read both scores against a common reported-load screen; preserve the unfiltered replay and identify the influential dates.

data.grain: One balancing authority and UTC date with 24 observed, forecast and lagged observations
